_comment: The shipping package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.9). They name only its own types,
granted to this library's one slot, which the application binds in its security.json:
An unbound slot refuses startup. Rows are narrowed by the IShipmentRowFilters the application or Shop registers (a
seller's staff see their own shipments); without one, every member of the slot sees every shipment. Nothing is
written by a form: only QueryRead and the custom actions are granted. The label and customs-document downloads need
Read/Shipment too. Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-shipping": false }.
